  - region "Simple English explanation of One-One Functions":

      - heading "Understand One-One Functions" [level=2]
  - text: CLASS 11 · RELATIONS AND FUNCTIONS
  - heading "One-One Functions" [level=1]
  - paragraph: One-One Functions are functions in which every output has at most one preimage. Do not confuse one-one with onto.
  - navigation: 18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT MAPPING LAB
  - button "← School lessons"
  - main:
    - heading "☷ MAPPING LAB" [level=2]
    - button "Reset":
      - img
      - text: Reset
    - paragraph: Build the mapping, inspect collisions, and test injectivity.
    - article:
      - heading "DOMAIN (x)" [level=3]
      - button "-2"
      - button "-1"
      - button "0"
      - button "1"
      - button "2"
    - img "Mapping arrows"
    - article:
      - heading "CODOMAIN (y)" [level=3]
      - button "-3"
      - button "-1"
      - button "1"
      - button "3"
      - button "5"
    - text: ⓘ Drag from a domain value to a codomain value to create a mapping.
    - article:
      - heading "COLLISION DETECTOR" [level=2]:
        - img
        - text: COLLISION DETECTOR
      - paragraph: Any target with more than one arrow is a collision.
      - text: "-3 1 preimage"
      - img
      - text: "-1 1 preimage"
      - img
      - text: 1 1 preimage
      - img
      - text: 3 1 preimage
      - img
      - text: 5 1 preimage
      - img
    - article:
      - heading "▥ PREIMAGE-COUNT METER" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Max preimages of any output (in current mapping)
      - strong: "1"
      - text: "Goal for one-one: ≤ 1 ✓ Met"
    - article:
      - heading "FUNCTION (example)" [level=2]:
        - text: FUNCTION
        - emphasis: (example)
      - strong: f(x) = 2x + 1
      - button "Edit":
        - img
        - text: Edit
    - article:
      - heading "TEST INJECTIVE" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Test the function on sample domain values.
      - status: "Domain sample {-2, -1, 0, 1, 2}"
      - button "Test injective"
    - article:
      - img
      - heading "STATUS" [level=2]
      - strong: Every output has at most one preimage.
      - paragraph: This mapping is one-one (injective).
    - article:
      - heading "LINKED MINI GRAPH" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Horizontal Line Test (no horizontal line hits the graph twice).
      - img "Function graph"
      - complementary:
        - paragraph: y = -2 0 hit ✓
        - paragraph: y = 1 1 hit ✓
        - paragraph: y = 4 0 hit ✓
  - heading "WHY THIS WORKS" [level=2]
  - paragraph: A function is one-one if no two different inputs map to the same output. Here, each output has at most one preimage (max preimages = 1), so the function is injective.
  - paragraph: This does not mean every output in the codomain is used. Onto (surjective) is a different property.
  - group: Additional examples and concept checks
